reader.reads: Read all four places in German and each thesis against its formula; read pages 95–98 of the 1808 scan.

johann-wolfgang-goethe.einfache-nachahmu.note: The passage says «er erfindet sich selbst eine Weise, macht sich selbst eine Sprache» to express what he grasped and give a repeated object its own form. The cut also includes five sentences on faithful imitation, its conditions and its practitioners; those sentences do not say this thesis, exceeding the formula. The opening «eine solche Art zu verfahren» requires the earlier context, but the cut should be reworked to give a bounded, intelligible formula.

The passage says «der Geist des Sprechenden unmittelbar ausdrückt» and «jeder Künstler dieser Art, die Welt anders sehen, ergreifen und nachbilden». Its formula also includes the five sentences of Manier p96 on faithful imitation, its conditions and practitioners, which do not say this thesis; Manier p96a repeats the manner passage already in Manier p96. The context and cut need a bounded, intelligible formula.

summary: The three theses are supported by the German sentences in both languages, and the pages checked agree with the packet. Two formulas include a long account of faithful imitation beyond the sentences that state their theses; they need a bounded intelligible cut.
